who said that on a Festival one may … kindle … with … vessels, … however, … one may not kindle … using broken vessels, … And, … everyone is of … in accordance with

who said that on a Festival one may only kindle a fire with whole vessels, as it is permitted to carry them and they do not have set-aside [muktze] status; however, one may not kindle a fire using broken vessels, i.e., vessels that broke on the Festival. Since they broke on the Festival itself, they are classified as an entity that came into being [nolad] on the Festival, and the halakha prohibits moving them.
